name: Whispering Willows: Deluxe Edition
storyline: Young Elena Elkhorn sets out on a harrowing search for her missing father, John, whose disappearance draws her to the sprawling and long-abandoned Willows Mansion. To aid her, John has left behind a unique amulet that lets Elena astrally project her spirit into a ghostly realm, where she can slip through the world of the dead and speak with the restless souls who linger there. As she explores the mansion and its haunted grounds, Elena uncovers the tragic history binding the estate together, including its former master Wortham Willows, a mayor consumed by his desperate quest to revive his dead wife. Caught between the living and the dead, Elena must piece together the mansion's dark secrets if she hopes to find her father.
